1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game targeting canvas with id="game"
2: // Controls: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight or A/D keys
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width;
9:   const height = canvas.height;
10: 
11:   const ship = {
12:     w: 40,
13:     h: 20,
14:     x: width / 2 - 20,
15:     y: height - 30,
16:     speed: 5,
17:     color: '#0ff',
18:   };
19: 
20:   let asteroids = [];
21:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
22:   let lastSpawn = 0;
23: 
24:   let health = 3;
25:   let score = 0;
26:   let lastTime = 0;
27: 
28:   const keys = {};
29:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
30:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
31: 
32:   function spawnAsteroid() {
33:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
34:     asteroids.push({
35:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
36:       y: -size,
37:       w: size,
38:       h: size,
39:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
40:       color: '#f55',
41:     });
42:   }
43: 
44:   function update(dt) {
45:     // ship movement
46:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
47:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.x += ship.speed;
48:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
49: 
50:     // asteroids
51:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);
52:     // remove off‑screen
53:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => a.y < height);
54: 
55:     // collision detection
56:     for (const a of asteroids) {
57:       if (
58:         a.x < ship.x + ship.w &&
59:         a.x + a.w > ship.x &&
60:         a.y < ship.y + ship.h &&
61:         a.y + a.h > ship.y
62:       ) {
63:         health--;
64:         // remove this asteroid
65:         a.y = height + 1;
66:         if (health <= 0) {
67:           // game over – stop animation
68:           cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
69:           alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.floor(score));
70:           return;
71:         }
72:       }
73:     }
74:     // score as time survived
75:     score += dt / 1000;
76:   }
77: 
78:   function draw() {
79:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
80:     // ship
81:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
82:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
83:     // asteroids
84:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
85:       ctx.fillStyle = a.color;
86:       ctx.beginPath();
87:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
88:       ctx.fill();
89:     });
90:     // health bar
91:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
92:     for (let i = 0; i < health; i++) {
93:       ctx.fillRect(10 + i * 15, 10, 10, 10);
94:     }
95:     // score
96:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
97:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
98:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), width - 100, 20);
99:   }
100: 
101:   let animId;
102:   function loop(timestamp) {
103:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
104:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
105:     lastTime = timestamp;
106:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
107:       spawnAsteroid();
108:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
109:     }
110:     update(dt);
111:     draw();
112:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
113:   }
114: 
115:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
116: })();
